column1: Shohei Ohtani leads the slate with a strong track record of consistency and a favorable matchup against Ryan Feltner, plus a park boost and platoon advantage. Freddie Freeman also profiles well in the same environment, offering reliable contact skills and steady hit rates. Andy Pages and Matt Olson provide additional options, but Ohtani’s combination of matchup, lineup spot, and recent form make him the most dependable pick for Beat The Streak players tonight.
